title: Lawn Stripes
statementMd:
Lawn stripes are drawn using a roller to flatten grass blades in a particular direction and impart a sheen that, at a distance, is distinguishable from blades flattened in another direction. This is typically for aesthetic appeal.

We are going to draw lawn stripes in our square garden using a roller in any of the $4$ cardinal directions. The roller must stay on the lawn throughout. The final direction of a piece of lawn is determined by the last time the roller ran over it, including starting from or finishing there.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c59cb4dd8a836bce2ea2d189da04ab804bf5c02.png)Illustration of Sample Input 1.

Given a description of the lawn and the starting point of the roller, determine how to draw the pattern.

## Input

- The first line of input contains the width and depth in metres of the lawn, $n$ ($1 \le n \le 100$)
- The second line of input contains the row and column of the roller, $r$ and $c$ ($1 \le r, c \le n$).
- Each of the next $n$ lines contains $n$ characters from `(l|r|u|d)` giving the desired direction of a square metre of lawn.

## Output

If it is not possible to draw the pattern, output `impossible`. Otherwise, demonstrate a solution in under $10n^2$ moves by outputting the number of moves to use on one line, followed by the moves on the remaining lines.

Each move consists of a distance in metres $d$ and a direction from `(l|r|u|d)`. A roller following the instructions must roll over every square metre without leaving the lawn.
statementZhMd:
草坪条纹是通过滚筒将草叶沿特定方向压倒而形成的。这样会使草叶呈现光泽，从远处看，便能与沿其他方向压倒的草叶区分开来。这通常是为了美观。

我们打算在正方形花园中，用滚筒沿上、下、左、右这 $4$ 个方向滚动，绘制草坪条纹。滚筒必须始终位于草坪上。一块草坪最终的草叶朝向由滚筒最后一次经过它时的方向决定，包括滚筒从该处出发或在该处结束的情况。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0c59cb4dd8a836bce2ea2d189da04ab804bf5c02.png)样例输入 1 的示意图。

给定草坪的描述和滚筒的起始位置，请确定如何绘制出指定图案。

## 输入格式

- 输入的第一行包含草坪的宽度和深度，单位为米，均为 $n$ ($1 \le n \le 100$)。
- 输入的第二行包含滚筒所在的行和列，分别为 $r$ 和 $c$ ($1 \le r, c \le n$)。
- 接下来的 $n$ 行，每行包含 $n$ 个来自 `(l|r|u|d)` 的字符，表示每平方米草坪所需的草叶朝向。

## 输出格式

如果无法绘制出指定图案，输出 `impossible`。否则，请给出一个移动次数少于 $10n^2$ 的方案：在一行中输出移动次数，然后在接下来的各行中输出每次移动。

每次移动由以米为单位的距离 $d$ 和一个来自 `(l|r|u|d)` 的方向组成。滚筒按照这些指令移动时，必须滚过草坪的每一平方米，且不能离开草坪。
